issues: React console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' causing a hydration warning on class options. Native <option> only allows text; remove inner markup/<span> inside <option> or switch to shadcn Select.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~640-line file. For maintainability it could be split into routers (auth / public / admin / export). Not a bug.
Session cookies set with Secure+SameSite=None; correct for HTTPS preview and allows cross-site auth callbacks.
Admin bootstrap uses $setOnInsert so the first login becomes permanent admin; ADMIN_EMAIL env also safely seeds on startup — good.
PATCH endpoint correctly recomputes final_grade from final_score, enforces 422 when finalizing without score, and marks manually_edited only on meaningful fields — spec compliant.
Metadata extraction uses facebookexternalhit UA; privacy fallback deterministically yields score 0, grade D, Indonesian weakness string — matches teacher prompt.
No MongoDB ObjectId leaks in any public/admin response (all projections exclude _id).
